Contact prospective students and individuals who have enquired about our courses.

Understand the student's interests and career goals and recommend suitable courses.

Follow up regularly with interested candidates and encourage them to complete admission.

The objective is not simply to make calls but to **understand the candidate's needs, answer their questions, build confidence, and convert genuine enquiries into admissions.**

Understand their basic loan requirements, such as the type of loan required, approximate amount, employment/business profile, and other initial eligibility information.

Explain available loan options and the general application process based on information provided by the company.

Collect required lead information and forward qualified enquiries to the appropriate loan processing or financial services team.

Follow up with interested customers regarding documentation and application progress.

Employees must **not make false promises regarding loan approval, interest rates, eligibility, or disbursement** and should communicate only verified information provided by the company or authorized lending partners.

Maintain professional and courteous communication with every prospect.

Make outbound calls and respond to incoming enquiries through phone, WhatsApp, website leads, and other approved communication channels.

Follow up consistently with leads without unnecessary or aggressive calling.

Update lead status accurately in the CRM, spreadsheet, or lead-management system.

Record important details from conversations so that another team member can understand the customer's requirements.

Provide regular reports regarding lead status and conversion progress.

Candidates should have good communication and interpersonal skills and be comfortable speaking with customers over the phone.

The ideal candidate should be able to understand customer requirements, explain services in simple language, handle basic objections, and conduct systematic follow-ups.

Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with WhatsApp, email, spreadsheets, and CRM systems will be useful.

Previous experience in **telecalling, telesales, admissions counselling, business development, loan sales, education sales, or customer service** is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with strong communication skills.

Fluency in **Malayalam** is preferred. Ability to communicate effectively in English and/or Hindi will be an additional advantage.

* Number of genuine leads contacted
* Follow-up discipline
* Qualified leads generated
* Course admissions
* Website quotation opportunities
* Website projects converted
* Qualified loan enquiries
* CRM/data accuracy
* Customer feedback
* Overall conversion performance

This is a **sales and lead-conversion role**, not just a calling position. The employee is expected to understand each prospect's requirement, communicate the appropriate service clearly, maintain systematic follow-ups, and help convert genuine opportunities into business while maintaining professional and ethical communication.

### **About Ascend**



Ascend is a premium travel company helping founders, investors, and executives book international business\-class and first\-class flights at rates typically 30–80% below those found on traditional booking sites.



The company combines proprietary booking methods with round\-the\-clock personalized travel support through WhatsApp. Ascend has grown from 12 to 66 people in just over a year, is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and has grown revenue 5x year over year to more than $22M ARR.



Ascend's clients include founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished travel service. They trust the team to manage complex, high\-value international travel arrangements accurately from booking through final itinerary delivery.


### **The Role**



We are hiring a **Travel Consultant with hands\-on Sabre GDS experience** to support airline reservations, post\-booking travel operations, itinerary management, invoicing, and payment verification for premium international travelers.



This role is ideal for someone with experience in **Sabre, airline ticketing, PNR management, corporate travel, flight reservations, travel operations, or business and first\-class travel** who enjoys detailed, process\-driven work.



Once a flight ticket has been issued by the Ticketing team, the booking is handed over to you. You will make sure the reservation and passenger information are accurate, prepare the complete travel itinerary and invoice, verify payment status, and coordinate additional travel services such as airport transfers, seat assignments, frequent flyer information, and special meal requests.



This is **not primarily a travel sales role**. The focus is on accurate post\-booking fulfillment, travel coordination, and delivering a seamless experience after the client's flight has been confirmed.


### **Compensation**


* **$500–$600 USD per month**, depending on experience.
* Compensation is reviewed based on performance, with clear milestones tied to progression.

### **What You'll Do**


#### **Airline Reservations, PNR \& Itinerary Management**


* Manage confirmed airline reservations and post\-booking travel details using information handed over by the Ticketing team
* Create or update complete trip records, including flight details, passenger information, seat assignments, meal preferences, and Frequent Flyer Numbers (FFNs)
* Review booking and passenger information carefully to ensure it matches the confirmed reservation and issued ticket
* Support travel operations involving **Sabre GDS, airline reservations, PNR details, itinerary changes, and post\-ticketing coordination**
* Build accurate, client\-ready travel itineraries for international business\-class and first\-class bookings
* Coordinate additional travel services such as airport chauffeur transfers, seat selections, and special meal requests
* Record all confirmed travel arrangements and updates in the client management system

#### **Invoicing \& Payment Verification**


* Prepare client invoices using **FreshBooks** based on instructions from your Team Lead
* Review invoices for accuracy before submitting them for approval
* Verify that payments have been received and correctly recorded before client deliverables are sent
* Cross\-check payments made through **Stripe, bank wire transfers, PayPal, and cryptocurrency** using Ascend's internal processes
* Identify discrepancies between booking, invoice, and payment records and escalate them immediately to your Team Lead
* Maintain accurate billing and payment records across multiple systems

#### **Client Communication**


* Send approved itineraries and invoices to clients through **Periskope**
* Communicate clearly and professionally with founders, executives, investors, and other premium travelers
* Make sure client\-facing information is accurate, polished, and consistent with the confirmed booking
* Keep travel records updated so the Client Service and Ticketing teams have accurate information at all times

#### **Travel Operations \& Quality Control**


* Ensure passenger names, flight details, PNR information, invoice amounts, payment status, and additional travel arrangements match across systems
* Update records in real time whenever a booking changes
* Ensure no booking task remains unactioned for more than 30 minutes during your shift
* Coordinate with the Ticketing team when a confirmed flight requires changes after ticket issuance
* Work with the Client Service team on client\-facing travel updates
* Escalate payment discrepancies, booking mismatches, or complex travel issues to your Team Lead promptly

### **What You Bring**


* Must have **1–2\+ years of professional experience in travel operations, airline reservations, airline ticketing, corporate travel, travel consulting,** or a similar travel\-industry role
* Hands\-on professional **experience using Sabre GDS**
* Experience using **Sabre for airline reservations, PNR management, ticketing, rebooking, itinerary management, or post\-booking travel support**
* Familiarity with airline booking workflows, passenger information, flight itineraries, and reservation records
* Experience creating or managing invoices using **FreshBooks, QuickBooks, or a similar billing platform**
* Experience verifying or reconciling payments through card payments, bank transfers, or digital payment platforms
* Strong attention to detail when working across multiple travel, CRM, booking, and billing systems
* Strong written English and the ability to communicate professionally with clients
* Ability to manage multiple active bookings and tasks without losing track of important details


**NOTE: Sabre GDS experience is required for this role.** Candidates without hands\-on professional Sabre experience will not be considered.


#### **Nice to Have**


* Experience supporting **corporate travel, executive travel, VIP travel, luxury travel, or business and first\-class airline reservations**
* Experience with international flight reservations, ticket changes, rebooking, refunds, exchanges, or post\-ticketing support
* Familiarity with other Global Distribution Systems (GDS), such as **Amadeus or Travelport/Galileo**, in addition to Sabre, experience using itinerary management platforms such as **Travefy, Axus, TravelJoy, Tourwriter**, or similar tools
* Experience with **FreshBooks, Stripe, Asana, CRM platforms, or client communication tools**
* Working knowledge of passenger information such as **PNRs, Known Traveler Numbers (KTNs), Frequent Flyer Numbers (FFNs), seat assignments, and special meal requests**
* Background supporting high\-touch or premium international travelers
* Genuine interest in travel and delivering seamless customer experiences

### **Why This Role**



This opportunity is a strong fit for an experienced **Travel Consultant, Corporate Travel Consultant, Travel Counselor, Airline Reservations Agent, Ticketing Agent, or Travel Operations Specialist** who has worked extensively with **Sabre GDS** and wants to move into a remote, full\-time role supporting premium international travel.



If you're comfortable working with Sabre, airline reservations, detailed travel itineraries, billing, payment verification, and high\-value international bookings, we'd love to hear from you.



You do not need to check every box. However, **hands\-on Sabre GDS experience is a core requirement for this position.**

title: Dir, Software Engrg Mgmt
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

About the team


The CRM \& Industry Workflows (CRM\&I) engineering organisation builds the products that make ServiceNow's CRM vision real: Workplace Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Field Service Management, Sales \& Order Management, and the shared CRM Foundation that underpins them all. Our teams operate from IDC, AMS, and EMEA, and our work spans the full spectrum — from foundational platform capabilities to the agentic experiences that define how enterprises serve their employees and customers.

  

We are in the middle of a fundamental shift. AI is not a layer we are adding on top — it is the new baseline. We are rewriting how products are built, how engineers work, and what 'done' means. If you are energised by that shift and want to lead teams that are living it, read on.


The role


This Director of Software Engineering leads the Workplace engineering pillar within CRM\&I. You will own Workplace Service Delivery and its adjacent integrations with CSM and FSM — building the employee and customer facing experiences that handle millions of service interactions across our largest enterprise customers.

  

What makes this role distinct from a traditional engineering director role is the AI\-native mandate. You will not manage teams that use AI as a productivity tool — you will build and lead an organisation that operates as an AI\-native engineering system. Your engineers work more like architects and verifiers than individual contributors typing every line: they decompose problems into agent\-sized tasks, curate the context that makes agent output reliable, and own the verification harnesses that ensure correctness at scale.

  

You will report to the Senior Director, CRM\&I Engineering and work closely with Workplace product management, platform engineering, and senior stakeholders to shape and deliver the Workplace roadmap for the next three to five years.


What you get to do


Lead and develop an AI\-native engineering organisation

* Build and lead two to three engineering managers who coach their teams to operate with AI\-native practices as the default — not the exception.
* Model and scale the shift from implementation\-speed metrics to judgment metrics: specification quality, architectural soundness, and verification rigour.
* Cultivate a culture where engineers own the correctness of output whether a human or an agent produced it, and are accountable for autonomous decision quality in production.


Drive the Workplace product roadmap

* Partner with product management and UX to define, own, and execute the Workplace Service Delivery roadmap — including employee self\-service, request management, and WSD×CSM/FSM integration.
* Translate ambitious product goals and ambiguous problem statements into precise, testable specifications that both engineers and AI agents can act on with high accuracy.
* Make sound architectural and sequencing decisions early, before agent workstreams begin, and course\-correct quickly when output diverges from intent.


Build reliable AI\-native systems

* Design the verification and guardrail harnesses — automated tests, evaluation suites, CI/CD quality gates, and least\-privilege execution environments — that make agent\-generated output trustworthy at scale.
* Oversee context engineering across your teams: instruction files, architectural decision records, golden examples, and agent\-readable documentation that drive reliable results from AI coding agents.
* Own AI reliability in production: monitor for hallucinations, behavioural drift, and safety regressions; maintain agent observability; and implement rollback mechanisms when autonomous behaviour deviates from intent.


Raise the bar on quality, security, and delivery

* Set and hold the standard for enterprise\-grade software quality — accessible, progressive, and responsive web and mobile experiences at the scale our customers demand.
* Champion security\-minded engineering practices specific to AI\-integrated systems: prompt injection defence, secret and data leakage controls, and tool\-access governance.
* Treat the development process itself as a product: trace failures back to missing specs or context gaps, refine evaluation harnesses, and raise team\-wide throughput and reliability.


Develop the next generation of engineering leaders

* Mentor and grow engineering managers and senior engineers, investing in their technical depth, leadership range, and AI\-native fluency.
* Create a talent environment where engineers who are energised by the AI\-native shift can build careers through some of the most advanced systems in enterprise software.

 **Qualifications**  

To be successful in this role


Experience

* 15\+ years of experience designing and shipping scalable enterprise software products, with significant time in technical leadership roles.
* Demonstrated track record of building and leading engineering teams that have delivered real production systems using AI\-native methods — agentic coding tools, AI\-assisted workflows, and autonomous agent architectures.
* Experience in CRM, ITSM, workplace service delivery, or related enterprise domains preferred.


AI\-native engineering fluency

* Agentic AI and autonomous systems. Hands\-on experience designing and operating autonomous agent systems — planning loops, dynamic tool invocation, memory management, execution policies, and multi\-agent collaboration — that select and sequence actions reliably in production.
* Context engineering. Skill in designing what information models receive, when it is retrieved, and how context evolves. Includes assembling instruction files, documentation, examples, and architectural constraints, as well as architecting retrieval systems, vector databases, and long\-term memory frameworks.
* Verification and harness design. Experience building the guardrail systems that make agent output reliable at scale: property\-based and mutation tests, evaluation suites, CI/CD quality gates, and provenance and permission controls.
* Outcome evaluation. Ability to develop measurable frameworks — benchmarks, golden datasets, continuous evaluation pipelines, and drift detection — that hold production AI to the same rigour as deterministically testable software.
* Security and reliability mindset. Working knowledge of risks specific to AI\-integrated systems: prompt injection, sensitive\-data leakage, tool\-access governance, and model abuse, translated into concrete engineering controls.


Leadership and collaboration

* Strong written and verbal communication — able to operate as a credible technical voice with product, platform, and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities and make clear decisions under uncertainty without waiting for perfect information.
* Conviction to influence product vision and roadmap, paired with the humility to listen, learn, and adapt.


Forward deployed engineering

* Customer\-embedded delivery. Experience leading or participating in forward deployed engineering (FDE) engagements — working on\-site or in close collaboration with strategic customers to accelerate time\-to\-value, co\-develop solutions, and unblock adoption of product capabilities.
* Translating customer context into product decisions. Ability to synthesise what you learn at the customer boundary — pain points, integration constraints, workflow gaps, and adoption blockers — into precise product requirements and engineering priorities that feed back into the core roadmap.
* Executive and technical credibility with customers. Comfortable presenting architecture decisions, roadmap trade\-offs, and delivery progress to both customer engineering leads and C\-suite stakeholders, earning trust through technical depth and clear communication rather than sales framing.
* Rapid scoping and delivery under constraints. Skilled at decomposing ambiguous customer problems into tightly scoped engineering workstreams with clear success criteria, then driving rapid iteration cycles — days to weeks, not quarters — while managing risk and communication on both sides.
* Cross\-functional coordination in a customer environment. Experience coordinating across product, sales, and professional services teams while embedded with a customer — navigating competing priorities, escalation paths, and success handoffs without losing engineering focus.


Technical depth

* Strong command of data structures, algorithms, system design, and modern software development practices.
* Solid data modelling background — relational and otherwise — with experience building systems where data model quality is a first\-class concern.
* Proficiency with AI/ML fundamentals: model training and evaluation, embeddings, and the probabilistic failure modes of LLMs, sufficient to reason about and debug model\-driven behaviour in production.


Even better if you have

* Experience with the ServiceNow platform — scoped application architecture, Glide APIs, or platform engineering at scale.
* Hands\-on exposure to multi\-tenant SaaS architecture and the operational realities of shipping to thousands of enterprise customers simultaneously.
* Experience building and operating agentic systems in a regulated or enterprise\-compliance context.
* Prior experience managing distributed engineering organisations across time zones.
* Direct experience leading forward deployed engineering engagements — co\-developing solutions alongside strategic customers, accelerating adoption of complex capabilities, and feeding field learnings back into the product roadmap.


Why ServiceNow


We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a professional environment built on collaboration and inclusion. This is an organisation where people with strong aptitude and conviction grow fast — working on some of the most advanced enterprise technology in the world, with teams that take the craft seriously.

  

If you want to lead engineering at the frontier of what AI\-native product development actually looks like in production — not in a lab, but at enterprise scale — this is the role.

title: Sr. Analyst II FP&A
description:
Overview:

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+  

employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999,  

Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event  

professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help  

them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people  

together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry  

through innovative technology that powers human connection.  

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone  

and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.  

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like  

entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and  

celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.  

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human  

connection.  

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**  

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At  

Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our  

DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to  

experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll  

thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering  

exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.  

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn,  

iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AIpowered  

collaboration, we’d love to meet you.  

  

**About the Role:**  

We are seeking a strategic, analytically strong FP\&A professional to join our team as an Senior Analyst  

II – FP\&A, supporting Marketing mini\-CFO, in partnering with Cvent's Global Marketing organization —  

spanning Brand, Demand Generation, Events, Digital, Product Marketing, and Regional Field  

Marketing.  

This role sits at the intersection of Marketing and FP\&A. You will be supporting Marketing mini\-CFO to  

drive marketing efficiency and ROI analysis, but you must also deeply understand the \*bookings and  

pipeline world\* — how marketing activity converts into leads, MQLs, SQL, pipeline, and ultimately  

bookings. You will help Marketing and Finance leaders answer the core questions: “what is working,  

what is not working, and where should the next marketing dollar go.”  

In addition to this, the individual would also be required to drive core planning processes such as annual  

budgeting, monthly reforecasting, and cost tracking, while building and interpreting the full marketingto\-  

bookings funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, cost per lead, lead  

conversion by tactic, and marketing ROI by LoB. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen  

with genuine fluency in what a B2B marketing function should deliver, and the drive to translate data  

into clear recommendations for the Marketing organization and senior leaders.  

This role involves frequent interaction with senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, and Corporate  

Finance teams based in the U.S. and India.


In This Role, You Will::
* Marketing Finance Partnership \& RI (primary focus)


o Act as support to Marketing mini\-CFO to support to the Global Marketing organization,  

partnering with marketing leadership to translate growth strategies, campaign plans, and  

pipeline targets into annual budgets and rolling forecasts.  

o Build, own, and continuously improve the Marketing ROI financial model by LoB —  

connecting spend, activity and outcomes end to end.  

o Develop and track key Marketing efficiency metrics, including:  

* CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
* CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)
* Cost per Lead/MQL (by LoB, by tactic)
* Lead Conversion Rates (by tactic / channel), CTR
* Marketing ROI


o Analyze the full funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, and cost  

per lead — and tie each stage to financial and pipeline outcomes.  

o Drive deep\-dive analytics on event ROI, digital campaigns, tradeshows, and content  

marketing performance.  

o Deliver a clear point of view on what's working and what's not working across marketing  

tactics and channels, with concrete, prioritized recommendations for the marketing  

organization.  

o Build and evaluate business cases for marketing initiatives — campaigns, media  

investments, Martech, and events — using ROI, CAC, payback to guide spend prioritization.  

o Support and advise on resource\-allocation decisions across marketing channels and  

geographies.  

* Bookings \& Pipeline Fluency


o Understand and work fluently with the sales forecasting and bookings process, connecting  

marketing funnel metrics (MQLs, pipeline, bookings influence) to bookings outcomes by LoB.  

o Partner on pipeline\-trend and funnel analysis — conversion rates, sales cycle length, and  

pipeline velocity — to assess how marketing feeds the bookings engine.  

o Align marketing investment views with bookings and pipeline targets so finance tells one  

consistent growth story.  

* Stakeholder \& Cross\-functional Work


o Partner with Sales, Marketing Ops, and Data/Analytics teams to ensure consistent, trusted  

measurement frameworks.  

o Create executive\-level dashboards, presentations, and financial insights to support strategic  

initiatives, and present them confidently to non\-financial and senior audiences.  

o Lead or support ad\-hoc strategic projects, including M\&A / acquisition integration and costoptimization  

initiatives.  

o Extract and analyze data using tools like Salesforce, Adaptive Insights, Excel, and other  

analytics platforms.
Here's What You Need::
* 7–10 years of experience in FP\&A, business finance, or a related field.
* Preferred background (either path works): experience in a B2B organization either (a) in


Marketing Data \& ROI Analytics, or (b) in Finance partnering with Marketing — with real  

exposure to marketing funnel dynamics and bookings/pipeline.  

* Deep understanding of B2B marketing funnel metrics, digital campaign dynamics,


channel/tactic\-level ROI, and a clear view of what a B2B marketing function should bring to the  

business.  

* Solid understanding of the bookings and pipeline world — sales forecasting, funnel/conversion


analysis, and how marketing influences bookings  

* Strong data\-driven mindset and the ability to structure and interpret large, imperfect datasets to


generate insights.  

* Expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, and metric development — including the ability to


think through a marketing ROI model from first principles.  

* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CRM, Adaptive Insights or similar tools preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights to non\-financial and senior


stakeholders; proven ability to work closely with senior leaders is strongly preferred.  

* Strong drive, curiosity, and willingness to learn.
* MBA or CFA preferred
